description: Thresholds and action classification for the Pharos stablecoin safe-mode gate

safe_mode_stress_threshold.description: Pharos stress score (0-100) at or above which safe mode engages. Below this, and absent a depeg, every classified action proceeds normally.

deny_on_active_depeg.description: When true, a confirmed active depeg engages safe mode on its own, independently of the stress score.

exposure_increasing_functions.description: Bare function names that increase exposure to the asset (e.g. 'deposit', 'mint', 'supply'). Blocked while safe mode is engaged. Matched against the attested input.function.name.

exposure_reducing_functions.description: Bare function names that reduce exposure (e.g. 'withdraw', 'redeem', 'repay'). Always permitted, including while safe mode is engaged - that is the point of a graduated response.

swap_functions.description: Bare function names that swap the asset for another (e.g. 'swap', 'exchange'). Permitted in safe mode only when the destination token is in approved_safe_assets.

swap_destination_arg_index.description: Zero-based index into input.decoded_function_arguments holding the destination token address for a swap. An out-of-range index leaves the destination undefined, which fails closed.

approved_safe_assets.description: Token contract addresses (0x-prefixed) considered safe destinations for a swap out of a stressed asset. Compared case-insensitively.

max_data_age_seconds.description: Maximum tolerated age of the Pharos observation, taken as the OLDEST of the stress and flow responses. Observed real-world lag is ~40 minutes, so sub-hour ceilings deny routinely. Null ages fail soft.
